Enterprise PMO · for the PMO and approvers

PMO governance reference

The rules the hub's flows apply: change tolerances, escalation and approval times, the early-warning indicators, the schedules and switches, and what to do when something gets stuck.

ApprovalsEarly warningSchedules SwitchesListsWhen something is stuck

Approvals and tolerances

DecisionApprovers (setting)RuleTime limit
Change request, PMO reviewCRPMOApproverEmailsEvery request. Rejecting returns it to the requester.14 days
Change request, Steering CommitteeCRSteerCoApproverEmailsAfter PMO approval, when it is a scope change, budget impact over £25,000 (CRBudgetTolerance) or schedule impact over 10 days (CRScheduleToleranceDays)21 days
RAID Board escalationEscalationApproverEmailsWhen someone ticks Request Executive Board escalation3 days

The first approver to respond decides. Approvals can be reassigned in Teams or the Approvals app. A request not decided in time becomes Decision overdue (change request) or Not decided (escalation), and the PMO mailbox is emailed.

Early-warning indicators

Every Monday, flow 02 scores each active workstream one point per indicator. It posts an advisory when the score reaches 2 (EarlyWarningThreshold, out of 3). The scores are kept in PMO Trend Snapshots for the Power BI trend report.

CodeIndicatorHow it is worked outScores whenSetting
RVEL-HIGHNet risk velocityRisks and issues opened minus closed in the last 7 days≥ 2RiskVelocityThreshold
ABD-SLOAction burn-downActions closed in 7 days ÷ (actions opened in 7 days + open actions due in the next 10 days)< 0.75, with at least 3 actions dueBurnDownThresholdPercent, BurnDownMinActionsDue
CHURN-CRITDate churnOne item's date pushed later within the last 14 days≥ 2 pushes on one itemChurnThreshold, ChurnWindowDays

Tune thresholds on real data before switching the cards on: run with EarlyWarningEnabled = No for a few weeks and compare the snapshots with what the PMO already knows.

Schedules

FlowWhenWhat
01 Daily digestWeekdays 07:00 UKOverdue Board escalations and Executive Board actions and decisions, up to 20 of each (DigestMaxItems), once a day
02 Early warningMondays 06:00 UKOne snapshot per active workstream per week; advisory cards at threshold
03a / 03b Churn trackersWithin 5 minutes of a changeDate pushes, original baseline, closed and completed dates
04 Change requestsWithin 5 minutes of a new requestReference, PMO review, Steering Committee decision
05 Escalation requestsWithin 5 minutes of the tickHead of PMO approval; flag and Steering Committee card

"Overdue" means past the date in UK time: an item due today is never overdue today.

Switches

Environment variables in the Power Automate solution (Solutions > Enterprise PMO Governance Hub > Environment variables). To stop all posting at once, set the first two to No.

SettingFlowControlsDefault
DigestEnabled01Daily overdue digest to the Steering Committee channelNo
EarlyWarningEnabled02Advisory cards to the PMO Risk Advisory channel (snapshots are written either way)No
CRApprovalsEnabled04Change request approvals (off: requests stay Submitted)No
EscalationAlertsEnabled05Steering Committee card when an escalation is approved (the approval runs either way)No

Lists

ListPurpose
PMO WorkstreamsOne row per portfolio workstream. Every RAID item, action, change request and document points at one. Flow 02 loops over the active rows. The RAG columns feed the Power BI scorecard.
Master RAID LogRisks, assumptions, issues and dependencies for every workstream. Items flagged Escalated to Executive Board show on the hub and in the daily digest when overdue.
Action and Decision TrackerActions and decisions from governance forums. Decisions Required by the Executive Board show on the hub; overdue Executive Board items go in the daily digest.
Change RequestsBaseline change control: scope, budget or timeline variance requests. Target of the hub's Submit Change Request link. Flow 04 runs the PMO review and, over tolerance, the Steering Committee decision.
PMO Governance CalendarSteering Committee gates, PMO working groups and Scope Control Board meetings, with submission deadlines. Created from the Events template so the Events web part can also use it.
Portfolio Document RepositoryApproved charters, PIDs, stage-gate submissions and closure reports.
Governance Framework and SOPsDelivery frameworks, stage-gate guidelines, PMO templates and standard operating procedures.
PMO Trend SnapshotsWritten by flow 02 only: one row per active workstream per week with the early-warning metrics. Read by Power BI for trends. Append-only; don't edit.
PMO Date Push LogWritten by flows 03a and 03b only: one row each time a RAID target date or action due date is moved later. Append-only audit trail; flow 02 reads it for churn.
PMO Digest HistoryWritten by flow 01 only: one row per daily digest (Title digest|yyyy-MM-dd). The row is claimed before posting so a re-run the same day posts nothing. Delete a Failed row to let a re-run post.

PMO Trend Snapshots, PMO Date Push Log and PMO Digest History are the audit trail: read-only for everyone except the flow owner.

When something is stuck

The daily digest didn't arrive

Check PMO Digest History for today. Failed: fix the cause (usually the channel, or the flow owner left the team), delete the row and resubmit the run. No row: check DigestEnabled and the flow's run history.

A change request is Decision overdue

Take it to the next Steering Committee. Record the outcome by hand: Status, Decided by, Decision note, and a Decision Made item in the Action and Decision Tracker.

An escalation request is stuck in Requested

Its run failed after claiming it. Set Escalation status back to Not requested; if the box is still ticked, the next edit sends a new approval.

A "Flow failed" email arrived

Open the run from the link, find the failed step, fix the cause and resubmit. See Stopping and recovery in DEPLOY-AND-TEST.md in the deployment kit.
